## Evidence details

### '94 Audi Avant RS2

- Queue ID: `fandom-family-1555c05ceeb491cb`
- Wiki evidence: [Hot Wheels Wiki contributors](https://hotwheels.fandom.com/wiki/%2794_Audi_Avant_RS2) — A dedicated page identifies the casting, its 2021 debut, GRX27 tool number, and HYW82/HYX60 2025 releases.
- Independent evidence: [Mattel Consumer Services](https://service.mattel.com/instruction_sheets/JGR28.pdf) — Mattel's instruction sheet identifies a Hot Wheels '94 Audi Avant RS2 1:64 die-cast designed by Ryu Asada.
- Machine recommendation: `create_new_casting` at family scope; variant remains `hold`.
- Reviewer confirmation: **pending**
